prompts.prompt: Use case: sketch-to-render. Asset type: top-down game-map concept art for Open Channel Offensive, a grounded 3v3 close-quarters tactical FPS. Input image is the exact layout reference, not the desired final graphic style. Transform this blueprint into a polished, realistic 3D architectural cutaway viewed STRAIGHT DOWN, orthographic overhead, roof completely removed. Keep the reference floor footprint, room arrangement, proportions, full-height cover locations, inaccessible areas, and ALL normal doorway gaps. Do not invent corridors or additional doors. Keep ordinary and reinforced breach panels INTACT, visually distinct plaster versus metal. The colored route lines, A/D/P icons, graph grid, document frame and all text must disappear. Show the entire floor with a small neutral dark margin, no cropped rooms, no tilted isometric angle. Furnish sparingly with industrial office equipment, sensible server racks in the site, a few desks, filing cabinets and wall lamps; preserve generous walking routes. Warm practical lights inside, cool blue night spill at exterior windows, tactile plaster/concrete, worn carpet/rubber, dark steel server equipment. Enough soft fill to read every room and all floor connections clearly. Calm restrained art direction with no busy small clutter at player height. This is a tactical floorplan with decorative realism, not a mansion or labyrinth. No people, weapons, logos, watermarks, text, route overlays or UI. Hard cover stays hard and opaque; window glass is not an extra playable route. Uniform readable wall height in cutaway with low top edges, so walls do not obscure the top-down plan. Layout A, SWITCHBOARD: rectangular 30 by 24 metre industrial office. Nine room zones: left column Reception above Lobby above Loading; middle column Meeting above Spine corridor above Workshop; right column Archive above Server site above Electrical. Site lies on the right center and has permanent entries from Spine (west) and Electrical (south). Two intact special panels: ordinary plaster at Archive-to-Site north wall B1; reinforced metal on Site west wall B2 below the permanent doorway. White structural walls in reference become thick grounded plaster or concrete, grey rectangles become full-height server/cabinet/machinery cover. Lobby staging is indoors at left center. Show the compact connected office layout exactly.
